ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: With the official opening to navigation of the ship locks on the Guangxi Xijiang shipping trunk line, the Xijiang trunk line is gradually becoming a “water expressway.” Read the following figure: <image1> What is one effective measure that should be taken in the lower Xijiang River area to control local flood disasters?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of the “Xijiang shipping trunk line.” The river trunk line extends eastward from Baise, Tianyang, Tiandong and other places in the west, passes through Guigang, Guiping, Tengxian, and Wuzhou, and continues to the vicinity of Zhaoqing in the east; therefore, the “lower Xijiang River area” mentioned in the question corresponds to the trunk river section around Wuzhou and Zhaoqing in the eastern part of the figure. Then reason: The question asks about controlling local flood disasters. The focus of flood control in the lower reaches is to prevent floodwater from overflowing or destroying the riverbanks, so one effective measure is to strengthen the construction of levees along the river, that is, reinforce the levees.
